cues.text: Hello, and welcome to “Under Pressure Enterprises”, Customer Service Department. This is Kelly. How may I help you?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes, I’m calling about one of your rice cooker I just purchased.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: What seems to be the problem, sir?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Seems? There’s no seeming about it! The blasted thing shoots hot steam all over the place, that’s what! It nearly scalded my hand when I went to open it. Why it could have killed the cat or something. It could have exploded and killed my wife and me!
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir, sir, please calm down. As long as the steam escapes the cooker, it won’t explode.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: So you’re telling me there’s no problem! Are you calling me a liar?
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir, no one is calling you a liar.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes! So I demand a full refund!
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Under Pressure will be happy to refund your money, sir. Now I just need some basic information.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: OK, OK. Sorry. I do tend to get a little hot under the collar. My wife tells me to slow down... So, what do you need to know?
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir, don’t worry. I just need to ask you the model number of the cooker.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Hmmm... where are my glasses? Ah, here! Let’s see... ah. It's R242.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: R242. OK, and how much did you pay for the product?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: 89.99 pounds. It was on sale, I guess I should tell you.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Thank you, that’s honest of you. Now, where did you buy the cooker? Which store and which branch?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: At that big Electric Life appliance store downtown.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: The City Centre Branch?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: That’s the one.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: And you say the problem is that the steam escapes?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes, it does!
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: No problem, sir. If there’s steam escaping, clearly the cooker is broken or defective. So we have an R242 cooker with an escaping steam problem. It was bought from Electric Life’s City Centre Branch for 89.99. Is that correct?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes, that is correct.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Oh, I nearly forget. When did you buy the cooker?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Just as soon as my wife got the crazy idea she’ll live longer if she stops eating good English food: roast beef and mash. No, all she says she wants is rice and vegetables and sauces you’d not soak your feet in!
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir, sir! When did you buy it?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Oh, there I go again. Let’s see... we bought it just six months ago! We hardly used it either. But six months? Is that too long? I mean for the warranty?
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Very well, that’s well within the warranty period. Now, what’s your name and address?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Name and address! What for?
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir, it is company policy. If you want your money, you must inform me.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Money you say? Oh, my name is Herbert Hewitt and my address is 84 Park Road.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Is that here in Coventry?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes. The postal code is B0241DJ. But I don’t think sending things in the mail is very secure or very efficient. I mean...
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Don’t worry, Mr. Hewitt, don’t worry. We can credit the money to your credit card. You do have one, don’t you?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Yes, that's how we paid for the cooker.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Oh, yes. We still have the number on computer. I only need to ask your card's expiry date.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: I’m afraid I never give that sort of information out. I mean, once you have that, anyone could go charging things and...
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: Sir! I said your expiry date, not your card’s password.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Oh, er, yes. Foolish me. Of course, you didn’t say “password”. Let's see. That will be April 2008.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: April 2008. Very well, your card still has nearly two months left to go. We'll get that refund right to you, probably by five o’clock this evening.
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: You had better! If I don’t get my money... wait, wait. Yes, I know I’m losing my temper again. I really am sorry. I haven’t had my medicine today.
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: And sir, just one more question for our record. How often do you go shopping at the City Centre Branch?
cues.speaker: CR

cues.text: Oh, well it’s hard to say. I suppose maybe once a month. But I can tell you this, if I don’t get my refund, I’ll never shop there again! (He hangs up the phone.)
cues.speaker: HEWITT

cues.text: (sigh) I think it’s time to start looking for another job!
cues.speaker: CR
